method_revision.reason: Six candidates across two prompt methods produced one two-way cabinet each time, so the generator cannot hold the declared fixed attribute form_factor=sealed_two_way_cabinet and a third prompt attempt would repeat the same bet. The declaration is what is wrong: form_factor is meant to be constant across every instance, and that value names the crossover topology rather than the form. What is constant is a compact cabinet standing on a shelf with its drivers on the front baffle, which three-way cabinets satisfy too. This revision also carries the level camera, measured to reduce reconstruction tilt on flat-sided objects, because the batch has to be regenerated either way.
method_revision.published_asset_under_the_superseded_dec: audio_playback/bookshelf_speaker/sealed_two_way_cabinet_walnut_veneer is genuinely two-way, so its record stays true; the new declaration is also true of it and it can be republished under the new leaf
